scene: The taxi driver takes your coins and points ahead.
picture: A flat side view along a stone promenade. On the far left, a yellow water taxi idles with an open gate. Next to it on the left, a smiling driver holds a rolled map. Centre, a brass meter sits on a post. Right of centre, an elderly East Asian man in blue flat cap, orange cardigan, holding a wooden cane faces left. Far right, the canal wall.
shown: an open passenger gate onto the yellow water taxi on the far left
a rolled parchment map held by the driver on the left
a ticking brass coin meter mounted on a wooden dock post in the centre
